featured_reviews.name: rajesh javalkar
featured_reviews.review_text:
False Claims of Wholesale Prices – Misleading Customers

I visited this hardware store expecting genuine wholesale prices, as they claim. However, that is completely untrue! The prices are just like any other retail shop, and in some cases, even higher. They are misleading customers by advertising “wholesale rates” when, in reality, they are charging regular market prices.

This is dishonest business practice, and customers deserve transparency. If you are looking for actual wholesale rates, I suggest checking other reliable stores instead of wasting time here.

I hope the store owners realize that misleading customers will only damage their reputation in the long run. Honest pricing and transparency would serve them much better.
